item.tib: kun 'byung shel 'od lta bu'i zhal shes
item.coloph: rlung sems gnad kyi gags sel 'di/ ta pi hri tsa nas rim gyis snyan du brgyud nas/ nyag sgom rtog med u ru bsod rgyal gyis nyams su blangs nas phul/ de yan chad snyan rgyud yin/ u ru bsod rgyas gyis phyi rabs don du yi ger btab/ de la kho rang gi dbon po/ kong tsha 'das kha la gdams ngag gcig rgyud yin/ nga yan chad la yi ger btab pa med/ ngas yi ger btab pa yin/ khyod la ma bzhag na rtsa 'gags su 'gro bas dus mtha'i snod ldan nyung bas ma spel/ las ldan byung na gcig brgyud gyis gsungs/ kong tsha bkris dar la/ gco sgom smon lam blo gros kyis longs spyod mang po phul nas zhus/ de la 'dro sgom bsam gtan shes rab kyis zhus/ gzhan la ma spel gcig rgyud yin gsungs//
